links.outcome: Agreement of AI-assisted FoCUS LVEF with formal TTE reference on same participants
links.effect: Overall ICC 0.904; weighted kappa 0.83 for LVEF categories; AUC 0.98 for LVEF <50% (sensitivity 92.8%, specificity 92.3%).
links.quote: The overall intraclass coefficient was 0.904, and 0.921 in the novice (n = 208) and 0.845 in the experienced (n = 216) cohorts.

screen.reason: Prospective clinical validation of an AI-assisted point-of-care ultrasound tool assessing LVEF by novice vs experienced clinicians at the bedside. It evaluates diagnostic accuracy and operator differences rather than testing a specific implementation or organizational safeguard.
